cases.question: 西部地区通过线上渠道销售的各产品，每件平均收入（总收入除以总销量）是多少？请按该指标降序列出。
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT product, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, ROUND(SUM(revenue) / SUM(quantity), 2) AS revenue_per_unit FROM sales WHERE region = 'West' AND sales_channel = 'Online' GROUP BY product ORDER BY revenue_per_unit DESC, product

cases.question: 2025年每个季度中，硬件类销售的收入、销量和每件平均收入分别是多少？按季度顺序列出。
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT '2025-Q' || CASE WHEN CAST(substr(order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 3 THEN '1' WHEN CAST(substr(order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 6 THEN '2' WHEN CAST(substr(order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 9 THEN '3' ELSE '4' END AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(revenue), 2) AS total_revenue, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, ROUND(SUM(revenue) / SUM(quantity), 2) AS revenue_per_unit FROM sales WHERE substr(order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND category = 'Hardware' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

2019年入职员工中，各工作地点的人数、平均绩效和平均薪资是多少？按人数降序列出。
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT location, COUNT(*) AS employee_count, ROUND(AVG(performance_score), 2) AS avg_performance, ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM employees WHERE substr(hire_date, 1, 4) = '2019' GROUP BY location ORDER BY employee_count DESC, location

cases.question: 列出平均绩效低于2.0的岗位，并显示人数和平均薪资；如果没有符合条件的岗位，请明确说明空结果。
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT role, COUNT(*) AS employee_count, ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary, ROUND(AVG(performance_score), 2) AS avg_performance FROM employees GROUP BY role HAVING AVG(performance_score) < 2.0 ORDER BY avg_performance, role

2024年注册且当前仍活跃的客户中，各国家的MRR总额和客户数是多少？按MRR总额降序列出。
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT country, ROUND(SUM(mrr), 2) AS total_mrr, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM subscriptions WHERE substr(signup_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND status = 'Active' GROUP BY country ORDER BY total_mrr DESC, country

cases.question: 找出客户数最少的套餐；如果并列，返回全部并列套餐，并给出各自客户数和MRR总额。
cases.oracle_sql: WITH plan_totals AS (SELECT plan, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, ROUND(SUM(mrr), 2) AS total_mrr FROM subscriptions GROUP BY plan) SELECT plan, customer_count, total_mrr FROM plan_totals WHERE customer_count = (SELECT MIN(customer_count) FROM plan_totals) ORDER BY plan

已完成订单中，各销售渠道的订单数、订单明细行平均折扣率和每单收入分别是多少？按每单收入降序列出。
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT o.sales_channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count, ROUND(AVG(oi.discount) * 100, 2) AS avg_line_discount_pct, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS revenue_per_order FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY o.sales_channel ORDER BY revenue_per_order DESC, o.sales_channel

cases.question: 按退款原因和支付方式组合统计退款订单数与退款金额，列出退款金额最高的前5个组合。
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT r.reason, o.payment_method, COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS refund_order_count, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id GROUP BY r.reason, o.payment_method ORDER BY refund_amount DESC, r.reason, o.payment_method LIMIT 5
